System Integration

MIRA needs the following permissions to provide full functionality. You can change these later in Settings.

Microphone Required
Required for voice mode and wake word.
Screen Access Optional
Analyze your screen and applications.
Accessibility / App Control Optional
Control supported desktop applications.
File System Optional
Search, organize, and analyze files you authorize.
Location Optional
Location-aware local weather, time zone, and contextual automation.
Display & Wallpaper Optional
Personalize system background, themes, and display settings.
